name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Salta province of Argentina. The project hosts one of the largest undeveloped primary silver resources globally, with a completed Preliminary Feasibility Study showing US$494M after-tax NPV and a 26% IRR. The company is advancing Diablillos toward a construction decision while continuing resource expansion, and also holds the earlier-stage La Coipita copper-gold project in San Juan province through an earn-in with Teck Resources.
